title: First-Class Appendices for Print Reports and Zwischenbericht Anhänge
description: Add first-class appendix support to the semio print system (print/tex/): an appendix is a document attached to the main report, behaving like a chapter — numbered A, B, C…, labeled Anhang/Appendix, TOC entry, chip styling, cross-referenceable via \appendixref, listed via \listofappendices. Fix a pre-existing bug where window registers (\listoffigures etc.) render header-only because semio@render@register reads the wrong body macro. Wire the feature into all six print templates (report, paper, flyer n/a, zukunftbau forschungsbericht/zwischenbericht/kompaktbericht). Then apply it to mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex: convert 9 Anhang markdown documents from temp/ into 8 LaTeX appendices (A-H), including a 67-project table with per-row avatar images sourced from temp/projekt_bilder/ (downscaled ~600px, copied into zwischenbericht/asset/projekt/). Update body cross-references to use \appendixref. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/print-reports-should-be-joyful-haven.md.
summary:
Restructured anhang/projekte.tex's Katalog from one 67-project SemioTableLong (using SemioTableBandRow entries as visual separators, each hardcoded "P01 · Title") into 67 separate per-project blocks, replacing the hardcoded PXX identifier with the auto-generated hierarchical key.

Each of the 67 projects is now its own `\subsection{Title}` (title stripped of the old "PXX · " prefix — the chip is the sole key now, e.g. "P.K.1", "P.K.2" … "P.K.67"), followed by the project's thumbnail + location/year/status line (same visual content the old band row carried, now plain content instead of a `\multicolumn` band row), and its own small `\SemioTableLong[text-size=8pt]{Bauteile}{...}` containing only that project's component rows.

The old "PXX" identifier was also the cross-reference key used ~80 times in the Quellen table's "Zugeordnete Ereignisse" column (e.g. "P01-E01–E04", multiple projects per source row in some cases). Added `\label{proj:01}`…`\label{proj:67}` to each new subsection (matching the old P-numbers as internal label suffixes only, never rendered) and replaced every "PXX" occurrence in Quellen with `\ref{proj:XX}`, so the citation-mapping table now shows the same auto-generated key (e.g. "P.K.1-E01–E04") and can never drift out of sync with the actual project ordering again.

Did this via a Python transform script rather than by hand, given the scale (67 projects, ~80 cross-references): parsed the original SemioTableBandRow/SemioTableRow structure into per-project chunks, generated the new blocks, and regex-replaced the Quellen references. Verified the transform was lossless before touching the file: confirmed a perfect bijection (67 projects defined, 67 unique PXX numbers referenced in Quellen, zero missing on either side) so no `\ref` could dangle.

Verified: rebuilt the zwischenbericht clean (zero errors, zero unresolved refs). Confirmed via rendered page crops that each project now shows its own chip-keyed heading, thumbnail, and table with no visible "PXX" text anywhere, and that Quellen rows render the new auto-generated refs as clickable hyperlinks (e.g. "P.K.3-E01"). Grepped the full rendered PDF text for any leftover bare "PXX" pattern — none found.
